title: The Shop on Juan Flórez Where a Dressing-Gown Maker Became Zara
conflicts: Why the first shop opened: HBR (2004) says a cancelled German lingerie order left the company's capital stranded and Ortega opened it in desperation; WWD (2013) says the couple, with several hundred staff, chose to sell direct; FashionUnited and El Mundo describe a planned move. The story gives both main versions with attribution. Also: WWD's 'Inditex founded 1975' (actually 1985) not repeated; Mera's son's disability described differently by El País and La Voz, so left unspecified.
notes: Both founders credited, as the AP and WWD obituaries do. Opening date 9 May 1975 and the January 2026 closure of the Juan Flórez shop are from 2025-26 reporting (FashionUnited, Euronews, RetailDetail).
